pages.text: Mystcraft reads pages sequentially. Terrain, biome rules, time, weather, colors, and special modifiers all feed into the final Age profile. Conflicting symbols do not cancel cleanly; they add $(thing)instability$().

Defined Ages are safer than vague ones. Terrain, biomes, time, suns, moons, stars, and weather all make an Age more stable when written intentionally. Random or barely-defined Ages tend to drift toward exotic or hostile outcomes.
